name: Slice of Scythe
source:
Play as the 19-year-old cousin of Death (yes, Death with a capital D, the Grim Reaper, etc.) and terrorize suburbia. you need 4 souls and $40 shipping and handling to win and get the hat of your dreams.

[[url=https://cnnmon.itch.io/slice-of-scythe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演死神19岁的表亲（没错，就是那个首字母大写的“死神”本尊），在郊区大肆制造恐慌吧！你需要集齐4个灵魂外加40美元运费与手续费，才能赢得胜利并入手梦寐以求的帽子。

[摘自[url=https://cnnmon.itch.io/slice-of-scythe]itch.io[/url]]
